description: This line plot illustrates the Micro F1 (%) performance across four different relation extraction methods—TACRED, TACRED-Revisit, Re-TACRED, and SemEval—as a function of the number of samples generated, which is presented on the x-axis labeled “Number of Samples Generated” and spans from K=8 to K=64 with labeled tick marks at intervals of K=16. The y-axis, labeled “Micro F1 (%)”, ranges from 25% to 50% and uses a linear scale. The blue line, representing TACRED, starts at approximately 22% at K=8, rises to about 28% at K=16, peaks near 30% at K=32, and then slightly declines to around 29% at K=64. The orange line, representing TACRED-Revisit, begins at about 23% at K=8, increases to roughly 29% at K=16, reaches a peak of approximately 31% at K=32, and then slightly decreases to about 30% at K=64. The green line, representing Re-TACRED, starts at approximately 35% at K=8, rises to about 40% at K=16, peaks at around 50% at K=32, and then declines to approximately 48% at K=64. The red line, representing SemEval, begins at about 42% at K=8, increases steadily to around 45% at K=16, reaches approximately 47% at K=32, and continues to rise to about 51% at K=64. Each line is marked with its respective colored circular or star-shaped data point, and the lines connect these points with solid strokes.
